projects.title: With the Heart and Mind
projects.description:
For nearly a decade we have closely cooperated with Vetëvendosje (Self-Determination), supporting their activities and election campaigns, producing some of the most memorable messages and playing a significant role in the continuous growth and success of this political party.

The Heart 2017

General elections of 2017 marked a historical moment for Vetëvendosje, doubling in size, unlike any other party ever in the history of our country.

The Heart, a symbol of Victory, Vetëvendosje and love for the country, designed and developed by our team, became the single most memorable election message…
